utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the third of August. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the mime act again?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Only just made it in, mind. Traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: You sound like you're still recovering from the walk across the car park.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I stopped to look at someone's new car in the car park, actually. That shiny blue one. Bit smarter than our usual collection.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one held together by road dirt.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we get onto cars properly—tested the main isolation valve yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Lovely. So that one's closed, then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, finished. Nothing further on that.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the line 1 mould temp on Tuesday. That's done as well, just for the record.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, that one's showing closed. We're not carrying it into today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona Doyle, can you send the shift handover report round next Tuesday? Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: The existing handover report, yeah? Not a new format?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right, the existing one. Just get that round next Tuesday; it's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, I'll send the shift handover report round next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: While we're on where things stand, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line 3. Still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, there's no confirmed date in what we've had back. Same position as before.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. That's a blocker update, then, not another chase we're allocating this morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Also, the shutdown on the fire panel is cancelled now, production need it running. That shutdown's off the plan.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right. The shutdown, specifically—not the same thing as a function test on the fire alarm panel.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, so I'll run a function test on the fire alarm panel by end of day. That's the 'if you've got a spare minute' one, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It is, Cal. By end of day, but keep it at that spare-minute priority. We're not bringing the shutdown back.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do the function test on that basis. No shutdown.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Got you. Two different things. Teams clipped the start of that and I thought we'd reversed the cancellation.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Um, just an observation from me: heard a slight rattle from the forklifts, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observation only. Not putting a job against that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly. Just mentioning what I heard, not calling a fault.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We do still need someone to grease and check the bearings on the GT1 Compressor Section by 11am. Normal priority. Anyone got room for that?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I haven't got room for it, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Nor me. Can't honestly take that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone else able to pick up those bearings?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Not me, I'm afraid. I can't take that on.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's still unallocated, then. No name against it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. GT1 Compressor Section bearings stay unowned. The requirement is still by 11am, normal priority, but nobody's accepted it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, can you swap the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I can do that. I'll swap the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's just the filter change, rather than anything wider on the unit?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just the filter change, yes.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Fine, that's what I've got. Tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right, I'll chase the purchase order for the water booster Monday. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie. Monday being today, just so we're all on the same page?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, today, Monday. I'll chase the purchase order. Important enough, but not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And that's separate from the blocked line 3 delivery we just mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, completely separate. The water booster purchase order is the one I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah Price, can you investigate the pressure drop on the AC1 on Friday?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the AC1 on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry—Friday, not being pulled into today's jobs, then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, on Friday. Not today.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, that's fine. I've got Friday for that investigation.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll update the risk assessment for work on the booster pump after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Davey. Top priority please, that risk assessment.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Understood. I'll update it after lunch, top priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's the assessment for the work, yeah—not saying the physical work's happening after lunch?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, just updating the risk assessment. I'm not booking in the actual pump work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Sorry, we talked over each other there, but I think we've got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And mine's next Tuesday for sending the shift handover report round. I've kept your 'fairly important' against it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, exactly.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I've got the fire alarm panel function test as the spare-minute one, by end of day. Not the cancelled shutdown.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep. Shutdown remains cancelled; production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Mine are clear: IM1 hydraulic unit filter tomorrow morning, AC1 pressure-drop investigation on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And water booster purchase order chase Monday, today. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Booster pump risk assessment after lunch, top priority. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Only gap is the GT1 Compressor Section bearings. Still nobody taking that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. Still needed by 11am at normal priority, but unowned. Let's not pretend we've covered it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, thanks all. That's us. And whoever owns that blue car, brave choice parking it here.
